cohort: The study included 72 postpartum women admitted to a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Negative childbirth experiences were significantly associated with emergency cesarean sections, labor lasting more than 12 hours, failure of pain relief, absence of a birth companion, and poor staff attitude.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean sections were significantly associated with negative childbirth experiences.
cross-section timing: data collected in the first 48 hours postpartum
